subject: hermit crab
title: Hermit Crabs Line Up by Size to Swap Homes in Seconds

scenes.text: Hermit crabs run a housing market, and nobody tells them how.
A crab finds an empty shell that's too big for it, and it waits nearby, sometimes for hours.
Other crabs arrive and form a line, each one gripping the crab in front of it, biggest at the front.
Then a crab the right size claims the shell, and everyone in line swaps up to the next one in a flash.
Scientists call it a vacancy chain, the same way people trade up houses.
